name: Alpenfrieden
beschreibung: The youth hostel Alpenfrieden is situated in a Tyrolean valley and serves as a starting point for outdoor activities in nature. The accommodation offers functionally furnished shared dormitories and private rooms. Catering options include breakfast and, upon request, half board; a common lounge and storage facilities for sports equipment are available. The youth hostel caters to groups, families, and solo travellers. Guests can expect a simple, uncomplicated accommodation. The amenities focus on the essential needs of active holidaymakers, while the quiet location within the village ensures a restful stay after the day's adventures.
